Subject: PO request & onboarding form for Redwood Dedicated trial

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited to get Twilight Systems set up. Procurement asked me to follow up with the requested onboarding docs so we can get a formal PO in place. A few details to flag up front:

- Target start: Sept 1 (pilot, 3 months)
- Requested spend cap: $120,000 (for the pilot period)
- Line items: want separate lines for "Dedicated GPU hours" and "Support & Observability" so finance can map to two cost centers.

Can you confirm what PO number we should reference and whether your team can split the line items as requested? I attached the completed onboarding form and a simple PO template (PO_request.xlsx).

Attachments: Twilight_Onboarding_Form.pdf (filled), PO_request.xlsx

Best,
Alex Wu
Head of Procurement
Twilight Systems

From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@twilightsys.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-25T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO request & onboarding form for Redwood Dedicated trial

Alex —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the completed form. Quick answers:

1) We'll provision a provisional PO number today for you to reference internally while billing completes (internal token: PROV-11729). Once procurement clears, we mint the official PO in our ledger and send the confirmation PDF.
2) Splitting the T&E lines is fine — we need the exact GL codes on your side or we can map to two internal buckets if you prefer.
3) Spend cap: noted $120k for pilot. We'll set the provisional ceiling to that and loop back if we need a temporary escrow flow.

Monica — can you take lead on issuing the provisional PO and updating the line items in the billing system? Karthik, please flag any spendcap gating that would require legal/finance sign-off.

Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Alex / Sean —

Thanks for the GL codes and the updated workbook. I've generated a provisional PO token for procurement reference: PROV-11729. A few operational notes:

- Provisional reference (PROV-11729) is active in our intake queue and will be visible in your onboarding portal immediately.
- I normalized your two requested lines into our billing schema as: 
  1) "Dedicated GPU Hours" — qty: 800, unit: GPU-hour, unit price: $125 -> line total $100,000
  2) "Support & Observability" — flat fee $20,000 -> line total $20,000

The total ends up $120,000; support fee rounded to align with our billing minimums. If your accounting needs the support line to be exactly $18,000 we can pass that through, but it will change the compute hours count or unit price (we can accommodate).

Action items for Twilight: please confirm you accept the $20,000 support line (or provide a revised exact amount), and confirm the billing contact name and Tax ID so we can mint the official PO. Once you confirm, I will request finance to mint PO #11729 in the ledger and attach the official confirmation PDF.

Attachments: PO_request.xlsx (updated)

Monica Patel
Procurement Operations, Redwood Inference
